ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) base with high-intensity (white) spikes accounting for approximately 10-15% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark pixel base (#1A1A1A) dominates the medial sections. Light grey mottling (#A0A0A0) is visible on the distal lobe regions. High-contrast white geometric clusters (scars) are distributed irregularly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 125 degrees; depth is roughly 10% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Micro-serrated trailing edge with low-amplitude variations. Pronounced irregular jagged peaks are localized at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Continuous convex curvature sweeping symmetrically upwards and outwards from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white annular clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the mid-lobe surfaces, with higher density on the right lobe medial area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct near-vertical white linear disruption on the left lobe; multiple thin, diagonal white linear marks visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring including circular barnacle attachment marks and linear rake-like abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Densely textured, high-contrast white barnacle clusters present on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
